label: PF Backlog 514
title: E8: Requirements Traceability Matrix artifact (req -> design -> code -> test) + gate
body:
## Problem / why
No single artifact proves every requirement is designed, implemented, and tested (and that there is no extra scope).

## Acceptance criteria
A generated RTM maps each requirement to its design section, code, and test; a gate fails on unmapped
requirements or untraced code paths; the RTM is listed in the artifact->owner map.

## Out of scope
External compliance tooling.
